instruction: Configure VS Code to disable automatic file format on save.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring VS Code to disable format-on-save feature. Evaluator checks settings.json for editor.formatOnSave set to false. Uses existing check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checking if editor.formatOnSave is set to false in VS Code settings.json
Data flow is correct: vm_file getter retrieves settings.json, check_json_settings metric loads and validates the JSON content
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule': accesses expected['expected'] to get the settings dict
Complete coverage: the single setting editor.formatOnSave fully determines whether format-on-save is disabled
Expected value is semantically correct: false is the correct value to disable automatic formatting on save
Edge cases handled: metric returns 0.0 for file read errors and missing/mismatched keys
No postconfig needed: settings.json is a persistent file that can be read after task completion
